run_libsize_check: run libsize.py to check the file size of a compiled .so library file
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare current .so size against a previously saved baseline file
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py to create a new baseline size file for future comparison runs
run_libsize_change: run libsize.py to display the byte and percentage change of a .so file since last check
run_libsize_debug: run libsize.py as a debugging tool to track .so binary size regressions during builds
